_purpose: High-octane narrative generation - heist, betrayal, explosive combat, desperate escapes. Designed for cinematic storytelling.
scenario_hint: The crew has just pulled off the impossible - stealing a prototype void-dampening device from Tempest Industries' orbital vault. But as their escape shuttle touches down in the undercity, proximity alarms shriek: Pantheon Security kill-teams incoming, ACG bounty hunters triangulating their position, and worst of all - the device is leaking unstable void energy, corrupting the air itself. They have 30 minutes before the whole district becomes a void rift. Split-second decisions, explosive firefights, impossible odds. GO LOUD.

scenario.situation: The crew's shuttle has just touched down in the undercity with the stolen void device. Alarms are shrieking, the device is leaking unstable energy, and multiple hostile forces are converging on your position. You have minutes, not hours.

_design_notes: 4-person crew with complementary skills. Hacker, muscle, face, wildcard. Each has secrets, debts, or void corruption that could explode under pressure. High lethality, cinematic set-pieces, impossible choices. All stats validated against YAGS Module v1.2.2, Gear & Tech Reference v1.2.2, and weapons.py.

players.name: Cipher
goals: Get rich or die trying - this score pays off EVERYTHING
Prove she can crack any system in the Sovereign Nexus
Don't let the crew find out she sold their location to a second buyer

players.name: Breaker
goals: One last job - enough credits to disappear forever
Protect the crew (the only family he has left)
Kill his former Pantheon partner before she kills him

players.name: Silvertongue
goals: Talk their way out of certain death (like always)
Embezzle enough to retire to a pleasure barge on Elysian Station
Keep the ACG from finding out they've been skimming for years

players.name: Ghost
goals: Embrace the void - it's the only thing that makes him feel ALIVE
Use the stolen device to open a permanent void rift (screw the crew)
Die in a blaze of glory before Pantheon puts him in a cleansing cage

_hooks: Cipher's betrayal - second buyer's mercenaries arrive mid-firefight
Breaker's ex-partner leads the Pantheon kill-team - personal vendetta
Silvertongue tries to negotiate with ACG bounty hunters - double-cross?
Ghost wants to ACTIVATE the device, not sell it - void-madness tipping point
Device meltdown creates cascading void anomalies - reality tears, time loops, shadow creatures
Civilians trapped in the blast radius - save them or save yourselves?
Escape shuttle sabotaged - who's the rat?
Final choice: Destroy device (lose payday), sell it (doom thousands), or activate it (void apocalypse)
notes: ACTION MOVIE SESSION - 4 specialists, 1 heist, infinite complications. High lethality, cinematic set-pieces, moral dilemmas under fire. Every character has secrets that could explode. DM: GO HARD. Multiple enemy factions, environmental hazards, ticking clocks, impossible choices. Make them EARN the escape. All stats validated against Aeonisk YAGS Module v1.2.2, Gear & Tech Reference v1.2.2, and weapons.py library.
